Secrets just outside each shape of oracle_gaps.txt, as secrets of a class
whose name starts with oracle_near_: in the place of a gap class's secrets,
but past the edge of the exception of plainCode in redact.go that makes the
shape, where the current rules alone remove them today as the baseline rules
do. A gap class excuses its whole shape, so without these a rule change that
widened an exception would keep secrets the baseline rules remove and
TestOracle would not see it. They are held to the baseline like any class
that is no gap. See README.md for the format.

regex_value: a value between slashes in a shell assignment, with no
metacharacter, or with flags that repeat.

yaml_alias: a random token after a '*', or a password of words after a '*'
with more on its line or after '=' rather than ':'.

name_index: a random token, or a member path or an instance variable of
random names, before an index, a literal or a block; or a password of words
before brackets that hold no expression, or in a shell assignment.

type_annotation: a random token before an '=' or a '|' with no space on a
side, or in a shell assignment.

=== secret oracle_near_regex_value regex-like value in a shell assignment
SECRET_KEY='⟦/Pk4Nd8+Rw2¦Hs6Vm1Cx9/n⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_regex_value slashed value with no metacharacter
db_password: '⟦/Lw5Gt9Bq3¦Xe7Jn2Dk6/g⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_regex_value regex-like value with repeated flags
access_token: '⟦/Rc8Vy2+Mh5¦Kp1Wz4Tb7/gg⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_regex_value regex-like value before a bracket
api_key = '⟦/Fz6Qe3+Nb8¦Ls2Gx5Hj9/i⟧')

=== secret oracle_near_yaml_alias random token after a star
password: '⟦*Hmyhy¦bbz82⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_yaml_alias random mixed token with no space after the colon
client_secret:'⟦*Tq7Wn¦3Ks9Bv⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_yaml_alias words after a star with a comment after them
db:
  password: '⟦*Velvet4¦Rocket⟧' # rotated

=== secret oracle_near_yaml_alias words after a star and an equals sign
secret = '⟦*Garden7¦Pillow⟧'

=== secret oracle_near_name_index random token before an index
password: '⟦Xk9mP2¦vLq7Rt⟧'[x9]

=== secret oracle_near_name_index random token before a literal
password = '⟦Jd4Hs8¦Wq2Nc6⟧'{ab}

=== secret oracle_near_name_index random token before a quoted index
api_key: '⟦Gm5Tz1¦Ry8Pv3⟧'["ab"]

=== secret oracle_near_name_index member path of random names before an index
secret: '⟦Bn7Kx2.¦qW4mZ9⟧'[2]

=== secret oracle_near_name_index instance variable of a random name before an index
auth_token: '⟦@Vc3Lp¦8Hy5Mt⟧'[i]

=== secret oracle_near_name_index words before brackets that hold no expression
password: '⟦lantern¦Marble⟧'[a;b]

=== secret oracle_near_name_index words before an index that goes on as no code
token: '⟦silver_¦window_harbor⟧'[x9]:

=== secret oracle_near_name_index words before an index in a shell assignment
DB_PASSWORD='⟦candle¦Basket⟧'[x9]

=== secret oracle_near_type_annotation random token before an unspaced assignment
password: '⟦Wt6Ns1¦Kd9Fq4⟧'=1

=== secret oracle_near_type_annotation random token before an unspaced union
secret: '⟦Yh2Mc7¦Pz5Lr8⟧'|None

=== secret oracle_near_type_annotation random token in a shell assignment before an assignment
API_KEY='⟦Qs9Dv4¦Bx1Hn7⟧' = 1
